font.title: Font
font.description: Font family: a bundled one, or any Google Fonts family

font_size.title: Font Size
font_size.description: Letter size in pixels on a 1920-pixel-high frame; scales with the video's height

highlight_colors.title: Highlight Colors
highlight_colors.description: What the animation paints in; the first is the primary. A look that marks each word takes them in turn, a single shape (the sliding box, the bar) is the primary, and a sweep runs through all

position_x.title: Position X
position_x.description: Where the caption block sits across the frame, 0 left to 1 right; what it anchors depends on align

position_y.title: Position Y
position_y.description: The caption block's centre down the frame, 0 top to 1 bottom

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: How words move as they are said. word_highlight: the word takes the highlight colour. highlight_box: a box springs in behind it. word_pop: it grows for a moment. word_fade: it brightens, then dims. word_sweep: the colour fills it left to right. word_underline: an underline is drawn under it. typewriter: typed letter by letter. none: nothing moves. word_bounce: it jumps and leans. lyric_focus: the line is dim and the word comes into focus. highlight_slide: one box slides from word to word. line_bar: a bar under the line fills. stickers: each word on a tilted label. word_press: the word lifts off an extrusion. letter_rise: letters rise into place. word_slam: words slam in. drift: words fade in from a blur and the line floats. blur_in: words come out of a blur

word_spacing.title: Word Spacing
word_spacing.description: Extra gap between words, in font sizes

stroke_width.title: Stroke Width
stroke_width.description: Outline around the letters (0 for none)

shadow_color.title: Shadow Color
shadow_color.description: Colour of the shadow, with an optional alpha channel

shadow_offset_x.title: Shadow Offset X
shadow_offset_x.description: Where the shadow falls across, in the units of its blur. With no blur it is solid and drawn as an extrusion: the outline carried on out to the offset

shadow_offset_y.title: Shadow Offset Y
shadow_offset_y.description: Where the shadow falls down, as shadow_offset_x

glow_blur.title: Glow Blur
glow_blur.description: A halo of glow_color around the letters (0 for none): the neon look

fill_colors.title: Fill Colors
fill_colors.description: A vertical gradient over each word's letters, top to baseline; empty is text_color

extrude_shade.title: Extrude Shade
extrude_shade.description: How much a solid shadow (an extrusion) darkens from the front to the back

extrude_back.title: Extrude Back
extrude_back.description: The colour the back of an extrusion fades to from shadow_color; transparent for none

align.title: Align
align.description: How the rows sit in the block, and what position_x anchors: the block's centre, or for left and right its edge. justify is a poster: short rows, each scaled to the widest one's width

letter_spacing.title: Letter Spacing
letter_spacing.description: Extra space after each letter, in font sizes (negative tightens)

stretch.title: Stretch
stretch.description: How much wider (or narrower, below 1) the letters are drawn than the face

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: A multiple of the style's font size

letter_spacing.title: Letter Spacing
letter_spacing.description: Extra space after each letter, in font sizes

accent.title: Accent
accent.description: Set in the style's first highlight colour, so the accent follows it

box_color.title: Box Color
box_color.description: A square box of this colour behind the word: a label

items.title: WordVariant
items.description: How one word differs from the style's look; what is left out is the style's own.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Looks a word can be given instead of the style's own (a word's variant is an index into this)

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: The short side in pixels, or the source's size

frame_rate.title: Frame Rate
frame_rate.description: Frames per second, or the source's rate

green_screen.title: Green Screen
green_screen.description: Captions only, over solid green to key out, with no sound

format.title: Format
format.description: Format id from the format registry (mp4, mp4-hevc, webm, mov)

save.title: RenderRequest
save.description: POST /projects/{id}/download body: request a render in a specific format.
